captions.en: In 2022, debate over LGBTQ+ rights grew active.
Marriage for gay couples, respect for gender identity, the enactment of a non-discrimination law.
Japan has traditionally been said to have little plain prejudice against sexual minorities.
But institutional support has lagged.
To assure same-sex marriage requires legal reform.
But in the Diet, the proposal has repeatedly been abandoned.
Tokyo and many other local governments have introduced same-sex partnership systems.
Overseas, the situation is different.
Countries recognizing same-sex marriage now include many countries and jurisdictions.
The United States, Canada, France, Germany, the Netherlands, Taiwan.
Opponents emphasize on traditional family values.
But what is tradition?
Is something correct simply because it has continued from the past?
Younger generations are possibly more open on this issue.
Some polls show over 80 percent of university students support same-sex marriage.
Companies are moving too.
Workplace environments that respect LGBTQ+ people.
Diversity is a source of competitive strength.
There are additional issues for transgender people.
Strict requirements apply to changing legal gender.
There is diversity in how people live their sexuality.
The right for each person to live as themselves is one of the basic human rights.
